resources.string: "Your home screen, reimagined as a terminal. Launch apps, use everyday tools, and make a workspace that feels like yours. No terminal experience needed."
"Tap the input line and start typing an app name. Choose the matching app from the suggestions to open it."
"The chips above the input help you find apps, commands, and their options. Tap a chip to select it instead of typing every character."

"Type a command, then press Enter:
calc → open the calculator
help → read the offline manual
settings → customize your launcher"
"Next, choose your setup. Your choices are saved as you go and applied only at the end."
"Start with Basic, or choose Advanced for individual feature controls."
"This pane previews your border. Choose Dashed to adjust its width and gap."
Set Re:TUI as my default launcher
Open Re:TUI when you press Home. Android will ask you to confirm after setup. You can skip this and decide later.
Open Android Settings → Default apps → Home app to choose Re:TUI.
"Use colors from your current wallpaper. This applies the palette once; future wallpaper changes do not automatically replace it."

"Basic keeps weather, unlock count, and double-tap lock on. Locking needs Android device-admin access on first use. Optional drawers, integrations, notifications, sounds, and visual effects stay off."
"Lock with a double tap. Android device-admin access is requested on first use."
"These switches choose features, not permissions. Notifications need Android access; Termux and Tasker need their own setup. You can grant access when you use them."
"Re:TUI is an independent project, built with care and a love for doing things differently. Thank you for giving this little terminal a place on your phone."
"Your feedback, bug reports, ideas, and support help shape what comes next. Welcome aboard. Let’s build your launcher."
"Every choice can be changed later in Settings. Go back now if you want to adjust anything."
"Complete this quick setup to start using Re:TUI. Your progress is saved."
"> Rehearsing setup — no launcher settings changed"
"Setup could not finish. Your choices are saved. Please try again."
